about: FitFam's exercises and workout types, written by Cypher Sisters. Apache-2.0 License.

calisthenics.name: Push-Ups
calisthenics.desc: Fundamental upper push. Engage core, full ROM.

calisthenics.name: Diamond Push-Ups
calisthenics.desc: Hands close together targeting triceps. Elbows tight.

calisthenics.name: Pike Push-Ups
calisthenics.desc: Handstand push-up progression. Hips high, head to floor.

calisthenics.name: Bodyweight Squats
calisthenics.desc: Full depth, knees tracking toes. Drive through heels.

calisthenics.name: Pistol Squat Progression
calisthenics.desc: Unilateral leg strength. Use support as needed.

calisthenics.name: Bulgarian Split Squats
calisthenics.desc: Rear foot elevated. Deep stretch on hip flexors.

calisthenics.name: Dips (Bench/Parallel)
calisthenics.desc: Upper body push. Lean forward for chest emphasis.

calisthenics.name: Pull-Up / Inverted Rows
calisthenics.desc: Scapular retraction, full hang to chin over bar.

calisthenics.name: Chin-Ups
calisthenics.desc: Supinated grip. Bicep and lat emphasis.

calisthenics.name: Hollow Body Hold
calisthenics.desc: Lower back pressed flat. Arms and legs extended.

calisthenics.name: L-Sit Progression
calisthenics.desc: Straight arms on parallettes or floor. Compress.

calisthenics.name: Plank Variations
calisthenics.desc: Rigid body line. Anti-extension core training.

calisthenics.name: Handstand Wall Hold
calisthenics.desc: Fingers spread, push through shoulders. Stack joints.

calisthenics.name: Muscle-Up Progression
calisthenics.desc: Pull high, aggressive kip to transition over bar.

calisthenics.name: Burpees
calisthenics.desc: Full body metabolic conditioning. Chest to floor.

kettlebell.name: Kettlebell Swings
kettlebell.desc: Hip hinge power. Snap hips, float the bell.

kettlebell.name: Goblet Squat
kettlebell.desc: Hold KB at chest. Deep squat, elbows between knees.

kettlebell.name: Single-Arm Press
kettlebell.desc: Strict press from rack. Core braced, no lean.

kettlebell.name: KB Clean
kettlebell.desc: Hip-driven pull to rack position. Absorb at chest.

kettlebell.name: KB Snatch
kettlebell.desc: One motion floor to overhead. High pull then punch through.

kettlebell.name: Windmill
kettlebell.desc: Lateral hip hinge. KB locked overhead.

kettlebell.name: KB Halo
kettlebell.desc: Circle KB around head. Shoulder mobility and stability.

kettlebell.name: Farmer Carry (Single)
kettlebell.desc: Anti-lateral flexion. Walk tall, engage obliques.

kettlebell.name: KB Deadlift
kettlebell.desc: Hip hinge, flat back. Drive through heels to stand.

kettlebell.name: KB Thruster
kettlebell.desc: Goblet squat into overhead press. Full body power.

kettlebell.name: KB Row
kettlebell.desc: Bent over, pull to hip. Squeeze scapula.

rom.name: Pigeon Pose (Yin Hold)
rom.desc: Deep hip external rotation. Relax into gravity, breathe.

rom.name: 90/90 Hip Switches
rom.desc: Internal and external rotation. Functional hip mobility.

rom.name: Cat-Cow Spinal Waves
rom.desc: Spinal flexion/extension. Breathe into each segment.

rom.name: Thread the Needle
rom.desc: Thoracic rotation from quadruped. Reach through and open.

rom.name: Shoulder CARs
rom.desc: Controlled Articular Rotations. Full circle, max intent.

rom.name: Deep Squat Hold
rom.desc: Full depth squat. Heels down, chest up.

rom.name: Forward Fold + Ragdoll
rom.desc: Hamstring and spine release. Bend knees if needed.

rom.name: Downward Dog to Cobra Flow
rom.desc: Alternating inversion and extension. Full chain mobility.

rom.name: Hip Flexor Lunge Stretch
rom.desc: Half-kneeling. Drive hip forward, squeeze glute.

rom.name: Ankle Dorsiflexion Mobilization
rom.desc: Knee over toe drive. Wall-supported ankle stretch.

rom.name: Supine Spinal Twist
rom.desc: Knees stacked, arms wide. Decompress and rotate.

rom.name: Frog Stretch
rom.desc: Wide knees, hips sinking. Adductor and hip opener.

rom.name: Wrist Circles & Extensions
rom.desc: Essential for calisthenics prehab. All directions.

gym.name: Barbell Back Squat
gym.desc: Foundational leg strength. Full depth, braced core.

gym.name: Bench Press
gym.desc: Upper body horizontal push. Arch, retract scapulae.

gym.name: Bent-Over Row
gym.desc: Pull to navel. Flat back, controlled eccentric.

gym.name: Overhead Press
gym.desc: Strict press overhead. Core braced, full lockout.

gym.name: Deadlift
gym.desc: Hip hinge from floor. Full body posterior chain.

gym.name: Leg Press
gym.desc: Quad/glute focus. Full ROM, don't lock knees.

gym.name: Lat Pulldown
gym.desc: Vertical pull. Wide grip, squeeze lats at bottom.

gym.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
gym.desc: Shoulder stability and strength. Controlled path.
